title: Tall Whites say dominant species kill off threats
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of Tall Whites say dominant species kill off threats, about 1960s at Indian Springs, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest named Kurt Metzger retells what Charles Hall, a man who says he lived and worked near tall pale beings called the Tall Whites in Indian Springs, Nevada, in the 1960s, says they told him. According to Metzger, Hall made a point that the beings are not here to save the whales, and that they found it odd that humans ride horses and live alongside other animals. He says they told Hall that on most civilized worlds the dominant species kills off anything that could threaten it, a grim idea of what the visitors might be like if true.
